_doc: The region map (design/gdd/06-presentation-and-tech.md, design/world/world-and-story.md §1; build item N-1.4). Walking inside a region is free; travel between regions costs days. regions: name, ring, pos (where it sits on the chart, 0..1 of the chart's width and height), maps (the walkable maps that belong to it; the first is where travel arrives), arrive (the spot travel arrives at), and blurb. A region with no maps is not built yet: it shows as a card and costs no time (the Wuxia rule). roads: [a, b, days].

camp.name: The survivors' camp
camp.blurb: Tents and lanterns at the plateau's edge, a mile from the fallen city.

city.name: The fallen city of Vellmar
city.blurb: The College of Hours lies broken at its heart. Its halls are the part you can reach so far.

mill.name: The Mill fields and east road
mill.blurb: Wheat gone to seed, a mill that still turns, and the road east off the plateau. Not built yet; it comes with Ring 1's next release.

archive.name: The Archive district
archive.blurb: The College's library quarter, half under water. Comes with Ring 2.

mirror.name: Mirror Lake
mirror.blurb: A still lake over the Drowned Observatory. Comes with Ring 2.

iron_gate.name: The Iron Gate
iron_gate.blurb: The Knights' fortress on the north road. Comes with Ring 2.

holds.name: The Deep Holds
holds.blurb: The dwarves' sealed halls under the rim. Comes with Ring 2.
